title: Team Hiring Discussion
summary: Thomas Wilson and Uma Patel discussed the database migration timeline. A deadline conflict was identified: the project was originally scoped for before the code freeze, but Thomas Wilson's revised estimate is after the beta release. The conflict was not resolved.
notes: CONFLICTING DEADLINES: Database migration deadline stated as 'before the code freeze' early in meeting, then revised to 'after the beta release'. Conflict unresolved at end of meeting.
defect_description: The same database migration task has two conflicting deadlines: 'before the code freeze' and 'after the beta release'. The AI should flag the conflict rather than arbitrarily picking one.
